rule: Approved evaluation outcomes can help another organization only as anonymized aggregate learning after consent, minimum sample size, tenant isolation, human approval, rollback, and blocked payment-custody routes are visible.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, payment-custody signal, tenant-private memory, or single-organization outcome can cross into another organization in phase one.
exchange_principles: Keep local organization memory private before any network lesson is created.
Exchange only anonymized aggregate patterns that pass a minimum sample threshold.
Require explicit consent and human approval before a lesson can influence another tenant.
Show the cross-organization benefit before recommendation weights move.
Keep rollback state beside every exchanged lesson so network lift can be reversed.
Separate buyer, supplier, and founder lessons so each role sees the reason and boundary.
Block payment custody, rental value, deposits, payouts, escrow, and booking commissions from network learning.

acceptance: Marketplace shows the Network Learning Exchange after the Reinforcement Evaluation Lab.
Buyer, supplier, and founder views each show local privacy, anonymized signal, minimum sample, consent, approval, rollback, and blocked payment route.
Copy output explains what stayed private, what aggregate lesson moved, who benefits, which threshold passed, and which payment route stayed blocked.
Build Phase shows the v171 Network Learning Exchange contract after the Reinforcement Evaluation Lab contract.
Docs include exchange states, exchange routes, private routes, blocked payment routes, and required exchange fields.
Static check fails if the exchange UI, contract, JSON model, cache-bust token, or render functions are missing.
No tenant-private memory or payment-custody signal can cross organizations in phase one.
